<MethodEndpoint

  path={"/api/download_node_file"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Serves one of a node's files as a download.

Separate from get_node_files, which hands the whole directory to the
editor as text: this writes a file to the caller's own machine, so it
requires the **Edit node scripts** permission rather than the read that
opening a node on the Scripting page needs.

The bytes are served exactly as stored, so a file the editor cannot
render - an attachment sitting beside the script, say - still downloads
intact.
